name: Broken automatic door
locked_text: The door is stuck a hand's width open. No chance with your bare hands.
opened_text: You wedge the crowbar into the gap and force the door open with a jolt.

name: Security bulkhead
locked_text: The bulkhead is locked. The reader next to it blinks red: 'ACCESS CARD REQUIRED.'
opened_text: You hold the access card to the reader. Green light – the bulkhead slides aside.

name: Damaged oxygen generator
locked_text: The cover is secured with star-shaped special screws. You won't get anywhere with your bare hands … Maybe you overlooked something in the corridor?
opened_text: You undo the special screws, reseat the cracked line – and the generator roars back to life.
